description: Every place in packages/ that can make an outbound network call. scripts/check-egress-inventory.mjs fails when a source file matches an outbound pattern and is not listed under `files` here. docs/src/content/docs/data-flow.md is the human-readable view; the same test keeps its destinations in sync.

entries.when: Batched while a command or the console runs, when analyticsLevel is usage and the build embeds a key. Also one small event at first run, at each command, on a version change and on an error exit; not for --help, --version, shell completion, config, or CI and machine-output runs unless analyticsLevel usage is set in a settings file.
entries.sent: Anonymous counters and lifecycle events: version, OS, command name from a fixed list, outcome class, finding class counts.
entries.disable: DO_NOT_TRACK, ZERO_ENTERPRISE.

entries.when: A crash with diagnosticReporting automatic, or a feedback message the operator sends.
entries.sent: Redacted crash envelope, or the reviewed feedback text.
entries.disable: diagnosticReporting off, DO_NOT_TRACK, ZERO_ENTERPRISE.

entries.when: Interactive start-up, console update status, 0 doctor upgrade.
entries.sent: A GET for the latest release tag; the installer is downloaded on upgrade.
entries.disable: updatePolicy off, ZERO_NO_UPDATE_CHECK, ZERO_OFFLINE, ZERO_ENTERPRISE (CI also skips the check).

entries.when: Console model picker refresh.
entries.sent: A GET of the public model list; nothing about the operator.
entries.disable: DO_NOT_TRACK, ZERO_OFFLINE, ZERO_ENTERPRISE.

entries.when: A model has no built-in price.
entries.sent: A GET of the public OpenRouter model list.
entries.disable: DO_NOT_TRACK, ZERO_OFFLINE, ZERO_ENTERPRISE.

entries.when: The agent calls web_search (on by default). api.keenable.ai is contacted only when ZERO_WEB_SEARCH_PROVIDER=keenable, instead of mcp.parallel.ai.
entries.sent: The model-written search query. With KEENABLE_API_KEY set, that key goes to api.keenable.ai.
entries.disable: ZERO_FEATURE_WEB_SEARCH=0, or ZERO_ENTERPRISE (tool is removed and refuses).

entries.when: 0 sbom check and findings evidence bundles that check advisories.
entries.sent: Package URLs of SBOM components.
entries.disable: Do not run the check; ZERO_ENTERPRISE refuses the lookup.

destinations: github.com or the https git host in the source
entries.when: Installing or updating an extension from a remote git source. Local folders never go out.
entries.sent: A shallow git fetch of one pinned commit.
entries.disable: Install from a local folder; ZERO_ENTERPRISE refuses remote sources.

destinations: hosts declared by an installed connector
entries.when: Console shows connector status.
entries.sent: A GET with the connector token to its declared health URL.
entries.disable: Do not install connectors; ZERO_ENTERPRISE reports health as unknown.

entries.when: Explicit setup of the macOS sandbox runtime.
entries.sent: A GET of a pinned release archive, checked against a fixed hash.
entries.disable: Preinstall the runtime; ZERO_ENTERPRISE refuses the download.

entries.when: Console skills directory preview or install.
entries.sent: Read-only GitHub API calls made through the local gh login.
entries.disable: ZERO_ENTERPRISE refuses; the bundled catalog list still shows.

entries.when: Console repository picker and GitHub account status.
entries.sent: gh API reads for the signed-in account.
entries.disable: ZERO_ENTERPRISE refuses the repository list and token-expiry lookup.

entries.when: findings upload (SARIF), sentinel and host integrations that run through the shared gh runner.
entries.sent: The SARIF or API request the operator asked for.
entries.disable: ZERO_ENTERPRISE refuses to start gh from this runner.

destinations: nodejs.org, apt and npm registries (on the remote computer)
entries.when: 0 computers add.
entries.sent: Package downloads performed by the remote computer.
entries.disable: ZERO_ENTERPRISE refuses deployWorker.

destinations: the model endpoint the operator configured (provider base URL or gateway)
entries.when: Every model call and model-list discovery for the configured provider.
entries.sent: Prompts, tool results and code excerpts the model needs. This is the product.
entries.disable: Not disabled. Point the provider at a local or in-network gateway.

destinations: login.microsoftonline.com or the authority in AZURE_AUTHORITY_HOST, 169.254.169.254 (Azure instance metadata), the host-injected IDENTITY_ENDPOINT
entries.when: Only when AZURE_OPENAI_AUTH=entra. One token request, then again shortly before the token expires.
entries.sent: The federated assertion of the workload identity, or a metadata request for the managed identity. No prompts or code.
entries.disable: Use an API key. With ZERO_ENTERPRISE the public authority is refused unless AZURE_AUTHORITY_HOST names yours.

destinations: the provider the operator signs in to (OpenAI, xAI, Kimi, OpenRouter)
entries.when: Only when the operator chooses subscription or OAuth sign-in for a provider. API-key setups never use it.
entries.sent: OAuth exchange and the model requests for that provider.
entries.disable: Use an API key and a local gateway; do not sign in.

entries.when: Console connection status for a provider the operator connected.
entries.sent: A key-validation or usage GET with the saved key.
entries.disable: Do not connect that provider.

destinations: the OIDC issuer the operator configured
entries.when: Team sign-in on a server the operator runs.
entries.sent: OIDC discovery and token exchange.
entries.disable: Do not configure OIDC.

destinations: the SAML identity provider metadata URL you configured
entries.when: Team sign-in with SAML (enterprise license), only when the team config names a metadataUrl. Fetched on first use and again every 12 hours.
entries.sent: One GET for the identity provider's public metadata. No cookie, no credential, no user data. Redirects are refused.
entries.disable: Name a metadataFile instead of a metadataUrl; ZERO_ENTERPRISE refuses the fetch.

entries.when: Console or CLI talking to an engine on another computer, or the embedded local engine.
entries.sent: Console API requests with a bearer token.
entries.disable: Use the local engine.

destinations: remote MCP servers the operator added
entries.when: An installed MCP extension with an http or sse transport is used.
entries.sent: MCP requests and tool arguments.
entries.disable: Do not add remote MCP servers.

destinations: the git remote or URL named on the command line
entries.when: 0 scan with a git URL, 0 probe, and PoC steps against a target the operator authorized.
entries.sent: A git clone, or HTTP requests to that target. 0 probe also refuses a public host unless you pass --i-own-this with that exact host, always refuses link-local and cloud metadata addresses, connects to the address it checked, and follows no redirect off the named origin. ZERO_ENTERPRISE leaves it on, because you name the target.
entries.disable: Scan local paths.

entries.when: 0security scan --scanner nuclei --target-url, with a scope file or the typed host. 0 starts Nuclei, which you installed; Nuclei sends the requests.
entries.sent: HTTP requests from Nuclei to that one target, at 10 requests per second by default, from http templates only, with no redirect followed, without intrusive, dos or fuzz templates and without out-of-band callbacks. A public host needs --acknowledge-host with the exact host; link-local and cloud metadata addresses are always refused. ZERO_ENTERPRISE refuses every target that is not loopback.
entries.disable: Do not use --target-url.

destinations: the git remote and GitHub host of the repository
entries.when: Explicit findings fix, threat-model publish, findings import and sentinel review commands, and a Sentinel with release, check or pull request reporting turned on (off by default).
entries.sent: A branch push, PR comment or commit status the operator asked for. Sentinel polling reads releases, tags and check runs through gh.
entries.disable: Do not run those commands; use --no-pr.

entries.when: Development only, or same-origin requests from the browser page to its own server.
entries.sent: Nothing leaves the computer.
entries.disable: Not applicable.

entries.when: Talking to a terminal multiplexer on the same computer.
entries.sent: Nothing leaves the computer.
entries.disable: Not applicable.

entries.when: Matches the scan pattern only: text that classifies git commands or parses a PR URL/origin into a local identity. These modules make no network request.
entries.sent: Nothing.
entries.disable: Not applicable.

entries.when: 0 sbom check --outdated.
entries.sent: Package names of SBOM components (at most 200).
entries.disable: Do not pass --outdated; ZERO_ENTERPRISE refuses the lookup.

entries.when: 0 sbom check --registry.
entries.sent: Package names of npm and PyPI components (at most 200). Nothing else: no versions, paths or project details.
entries.disable: Do not pass --registry; ZERO_ENTERPRISE and ZERO_OFFLINE refuse the lookup and the report says not checked.

entries.when: 0 sbom licenses --resolve.
entries.sent: Package names and versions of components that state no license.
entries.disable: Do not pass --resolve; ZERO_ENTERPRISE refuses the lookup.

destinations: the repositories the project's own build files name (Maven Central by default)
entries.when: 0 sbom generate --resolve, after --allow-build-tools or a yes at the prompt.
entries.sent: Whatever the project's mvn or gradle sends: artifact requests to its repositories. The tool also runs the project's build scripts.
entries.disable: Do not pass --resolve; ZERO_ENTERPRISE refuses it.

destinations: the container registry of the image you name (the Docker daemon pulls it); with --sandbox-network or --sandbox-setup, whatever the build downloads
entries.when: 0 findings fix --sandbox docker. The container has no network unless you pass --sandbox-network; ZERO_ENTERPRISE refuses --sandbox-network and --sandbox-setup.
entries.sent: Nothing from 0. The Docker daemon pulls the image when it is not present.
entries.disable: Do not pass --sandbox; use a local image so nothing is pulled.

destinations: api.bitbucket.org (Bitbucket Cloud) or the Bitbucket Data Center URL you pass
entries.when: Explicit `0 findings upload --to bitbucket-cloud|bitbucket-dc` with BITBUCKET_TOKEN set; without the token it only prints the payload.
entries.sent: A Code Insights report and annotations built from the scan's findings, with the token in the Authorization header. A plain http:// URL is refused unless the host is this machine or --allow-insecure-http is passed.
entries.disable: Do not run the command, or leave BITBUCKET_TOKEN unset (the payload is printed instead).

destinations: api.bitbucket.org (Bitbucket Cloud) or the Bitbucket Data Center URL you pass, and the git remote of the clone you name
entries.when: Explicit `0 sentinels bitbucket review` or `watch`, with BITBUCKET_TOKEN set, or an enabled `bitbucket-pr` Sentinel trigger whose token variable is set. The webhook server and the signed webhook route only listen; they send nothing.
entries.sent: Reads of pull requests, diffs and comments; comments, a Code Insights report and its annotations, with the token as a bearer header. The scan fetches the pull request's commit from the clone's git remote. A plain http:// URL is refused unless the host is this machine or --allow-insecure-http is passed. ZERO_ENTERPRISE blocks requests unless ZERO_BITBUCKET_URL explicitly permits their exact origin and context path. Restricted git transport must use direct HTTPS; SSH and URL rewriting are refused.
entries.disable: Do not run the commands, or set ZERO_ENTERPRISE without a ZERO_BITBUCKET_URL exception.

destinations: the https collector or syslog-over-TLS host you set in ZERO_AUDIT_SINK_URL
entries.when: Server mode, only when ZERO_AUDIT_SINK_URL is set in the process environment. Off by default. Never read from a repository, a project file or the database.
entries.sent: Batches of audit events (action, actor, subject, outcome, whitelisted and redacted detail), with ZERO_AUDIT_SINK_TOKEN as a bearer token when set. Plain http and plain TCP syslog are refused except to this machine; UDP is refused.
entries.disable: Leave ZERO_AUDIT_SINK_URL unset.

destinations: the PostgreSQL server you set in ZERO_HA_DATABASE_URL or ZERO_HA_DATABASE_URL_FILE
entries.when: Server mode with the ha license feature, only when ZERO_HA_DATABASE_URL or ZERO_HA_DATABASE_URL_FILE is set in the process environment. Off by default. Never read from a repository, a project file or the database.
entries.sent: SQL over a connection to your database: server sign-in sessions as hashed keys, account ids, roles and expiry times, and the schema migration table. A server on another machine must use TLS (sslmode require, verify-ca or verify-full). The connection string holds a password and is never logged or sent anywhere else.
entries.disable: Leave both variables unset.

destinations: the https URL of your own shared findings server, named with --to
entries.when: Explicit `0 findings upload <file> --to https://...` with ZERO_FINDINGS_API_KEY set. Nothing is sent without both.
entries.sent: The SARIF or findings JSON file you name, with repository, source, commit and ref labels, and the key in the Authorization header. A plain http:// URL is refused unless the host is this machine or --allow-insecure-http is passed. Redirects are not followed.
entries.disable: Do not run the command, or leave ZERO_FINDINGS_API_KEY unset.

destinations: api.bitbucket.org for Cloud REST, bitbucket.org for Cloud git, or the configured Bitbucket Data Center origin and context path
entries.when: Explicit findings fix with PR creation enabled. Local origin selection/config inspection itself sends nothing; publishing uses the selected git runner and REST client.
entries.sent: The fix branch, PR title and description, draft state and reviewer identities; reads of matching PRs, lifecycle, commits and build statuses. REST carries BITBUCKET_TOKEN in a bearer header; git uses separately configured credentials. ZERO_ENTERPRISE blocks both transports unless ZERO_BITBUCKET_URL approves the actual destination origin/context. Restricted git requires HTTPS and rejects URL rewrites, differing push destinations and changed origins; redirects are refused.
entries.disable: Use --no-pr. Under ZERO_ENTERPRISE, leave ZERO_BITBUCKET_URL unset to keep Bitbucket blocked.

destinations: GitHub through gh, api.bitbucket.org, or the configured Bitbucket Data Center origin and context path
entries.when: Opening a finding fix review reads current CI status, with a shared 30-second cache. Explicit run-metrics host refresh reads lifecycle and CI status for at most 20 recorded PRs per bounded invocation.
entries.sent: Repository, PR and commit identifiers with code-host authentication. Only status/lifecycle reads; no source code, findings bodies or local checkout paths are uploaded. Each request is bound to the selected origin repository and has a deadline. Git commands here inspect local configuration only. ZERO_ENTERPRISE blocks gh; Bitbucket reads require the explicit ZERO_BITBUCKET_URL origin/context exception.
entries.disable: Do not open hosted fix review or request metrics refresh. Under ZERO_ENTERPRISE, leave ZERO_BITBUCKET_URL unset to keep Bitbucket reads blocked.
